cohort: 100 patients at a postgraduate medical institution in Peshawar, excluding those with allergies to prostaglandin, prior c-section/hysterectomy, active vaginal bleeding, severe asthma, and epilepsy.
finding: Vaginal misoprostol was 90% effective for second trimester pregnancy termination within 48 hours, with a median induction-termination interval of 16 hours.
